column1: # gimpel -- programs the ORACLE cannot grade. A RULING about sbl -bf and about what this
# package ships, never about us: an entry here is disputable, and nobody owes work on it.
# Authored hq_P 2026-09-06 from a measured run of the oracle over every entry, one at a time.
# ⛔ RE-DERIVED 2026-09-25 (coo, ceo CEO-1269, CEO-700 applied): a LIBRARY is the program and NAME_driver.sno is its grading
# vehicle, never a program in the shipped population. So the 148 CONTAINER_OR_LIBRARY rows that stood here ("a library module,
# not a program") are gone -- each library is graded through its driver -- and the 12 rows that named a DRIVER now name its
# LIBRARY, the oracle's own reason kept word for word after the driver's name. Shipped 292 -> 148 (lib_inventory.sh excludes
# *_driver.sno); the four libraries with no driver are UNGRADED.tsv NEEDS_DRIVER.
